usedFor: Zoho Inventory holds sales orders, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computer when “New Salesorder” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Salesorder” in Zoho Inventory, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new sales order can start a script on your own machine, such as one that prints a pick list.

watchOut: “Trigger Command” runs on your computers, and “New Salesorder” is polling, so the run follows a scheduled check.
